messages.subject: Simulation in Shiny
parts:
My app will take two user inputted values, run them through a function, and output the outcome of the function.  My function takes two input values, runs a monte carlo simulation on those values, and spits out some outcome.

This function works perfectly fine in R and RStudio, but when I embed the function inside my shiny app, it doesn't look like the simulation portion of my function is working.  Everytime I reload my app (or hit the actionButton) with the same input values I'm getting identical results (i should get different results due to the randomness of each simulation).

Is there something specific I need to do to ensure my simulation re-runs each time I run my app?

messages.subject: Re: Simulation in Shiny

Hi Gary,

It's often useful if you include a minimal example of what you are trying to do - I think you can include calls to your MonteCarlo function without source.

At any rate - I found this article to be a well written explanation of how reactivity works in shiny (and which values get cached in subsequent calls).

http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/execution-scheduling.html
